label: Fraud / unauthorised
description: Cardholder says they did not authorise the payment.
guidance: Show the customer was real and present: address, phone, email, GPS check-in, completion signature, AVS/CVV match, receipt.

label: Service not provided
description: Customer says the work was never done.
guidance: Prove the job happened: GPS check-in, after photos, completion signature, job description.

label: Not as described
description: Customer says the work did not match what was agreed.
guidance: Show what was agreed and delivered: signed estimate, line items, before/after photos, detailed description, accepted terms.

label: Duplicate charge
description: Customer says they were charged twice.
guidance: Show the charges are for different jobs or that one was refunded: invoices, receipts.

label: Credit not processed
description: Customer says a promised refund never arrived.
guidance: Show the refund policy the customer accepted (terms) and any refund already issued.
